name: OmaBlackbox
author: Ronald Craig
description: Decodes GPU, PCIe, memory and storage faults from the kernel log and flags sessions that ended without a clean shutdown.

barWidget.description: A quiet dot that lights up when the kernel reports a hardware fault, with a timeline of what happened.

schema.label: Show events of at least
schema.description: Notice includes corrected PCIe errors and kernel warnings, which are usually harmless.

schema.label: History (days)
schema.description: How far back to look in the journal.

schema.label: Sessions to scan
schema.description: Finished sessions are cached, so a high number costs almost nothing after the first run.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Announce a new critical event, and a session that ended without a clean shutdown.

schema.label: Mask identifiers
schema.description: Mask MAC and IP addresses, UUIDs, serial numbers and home paths in the panel and in reports.

schema.label: Preview with sample events
schema.description: Shows sample data so you can see how OmaBlackbox looks. Nothing is read from your journal, saved or announced while a preview is on.
